notes.subject: ofa bilong tenkyu i gat maun
notes.rationale: מחמץ: ofa i gat maun — Lo 2:11 i tambuim maun long ofa, olsem na Amos i tokim pasin bilong ol i no stret (tasol sumatin tok: maun i orait long ofa bilong tenkyu, Deut 26).

notes.subject: ol kotim ol ofa
notes.rationale: Paslain bilong Amos 4:4-5 em i tok pasin bilong ol long pasin narakain — ironi, i no tok stret long ol.

notes.subject: ol pikinini bilong Yisrael
notes.rationale: Yahwe i tokim Yisrael dairek olsem pikinini man i no truet.

translation: Na kukim kamap gutpela smel long ofa bilong tenkyu i gat maun, na kotim ol ofa bilong laik bilong yet, autim ol i klia: bilong wanem, olsem ia yumipela i laikim, ol pikinini bilong Yisrael, tok bilong Adonai Yahwe.

tokens.gloss: ol ofa bilong laik bilong yet
